description: This file defines the TimesheetItem entity class for the OrangeHRM TimePlugin, representing individual time entries with properties like date, duration, comments, and associations to Employee, Project, and Timesheet entities. It utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes accessor methods.

classes.name: TimesheetItem
classes.description: Entity class representing a timesheet entry with properties like date, duration, comment, and relationships to employee, project, project activity, and timesheet entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the timesheet item.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the timesheet item.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date of the timesheet entry.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the timesheet entry.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Returns the duration of the work logged, in seconds.

methods.name: setDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration of the work logged.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves the comment associated with the timesheet entry.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a comment for the timesheet entry.

methods.name: setTimesheet
methods.description: Associates a Timesheet with this entry.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Associates a Project with this timesheet item.

methods.name: setProjectActivity
methods.description: Associates a ProjectActivity with this timesheet item.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity related to this entry.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this timesheet item.
